title: Excel Financial Tracker
boundary: Design a user-friendly Excel expense tracker focused on Utilities, Renovation Expenses, and Homeowners Association (HOA) Fees, with organized data entry and review structure.
acceptance: A clean Excel workbook that makes expense entry and review straightforward, with the requested expense categories clearly represented and usable without special add-ins.
result: PASS — polished Excel expense tracker built from the public specification; formula scan returned zero errors and the independent sample totals reconcile at $8,166.82.
next_movement: Review the completed workbook/proposal and submit if desired; adapt categories/layout to client data if the client requests changes.
resume_bullets: Built a native Excel expense tracker with validated transaction entry, automated month/review logic, year-selectable SUMIFS summaries, and dashboard charts.
Independently reconciled a $8,166.82 sample ledger across Utilities, Renovation Expenses, and HOA Fees with zero formula-error matches.
notes: Public listing was open for bidding when captured on 2026-10-03.
